product_metadata.title: Jay Franco Addams Family Creeper Single Reversible Pillowcase with Handles/Trick-or-Treat Bag/Halloween Pillowcase
features: BOLD & FUN DESIGN - Pillowcase measures 20 x 30 inches. With unique design on the front and back, this Addams Family pillowcase features Gomez, Morticia, Wednesday, Pugsley, Uncle Fester, Cousin Itt, and Lurch. Add a touch of spookyness to your room with our super soft pillowcase.
HIGH QUALITY & EASY CARE - This Addams Family pillowcase is made of super soft microfiber. Durable fabric lasts long and does not fade after washing. Easy care machine washable, polyester.

PERFECT FOR HALLOWEEN – Pillowcase includes handles to use as a trick-or-treat bag during Halloween. This will make your loved one excited for bed time or excited to go trick-or-treating . Collect additional designs to take with you on the go for all your travel needs or trick-or-treating needs.
SHOP THE ADDAMS FAMILY COLLECTION - Complete your bedroom with our other Addamas Family products - Coordinating bedding and accessories available (sold separately).

OUR FAMILY COMPANY - Our company is still small and family run. We take great pride in our products and our unsurpassed customer service. We know that our wonderful customers are the reason we are in business! We offer excellent quality, non-toxic products. With our coordinating accessories, you can mix and match our high-quality and unique boy’s comforter sets, girl’s comforter sets, kids sheet sets, or kids pillows.
